description.value: Britannia Brewing Co. is a nautically-themed craft brewery operating a Brewery & Tap House in Lake Country near Kelowna, one of several BC locations. Their lineup spans West Coast IPAs, farmhouse saisons, Gose-style watermelon sours, oatmeal stouts, and classic lagers — all with ocean-inspired names. The Lake Country tap house sits in the heart of the Okanagan's popular cycling corridor connecting Kelowna-area wineries and trails.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at bbco.ca confirms an active multi-location craft brewery with a 'Lake Country Brewery & Tap House' in the Kelowna area, consistent with the OSM coordinates on Jim Bailey Road. The OSM name 'Brittannia Brewing Co.' is misspelled — the website consistently uses 'Britannia Brewing Co.' The website provides a phone number (+604-273-9379) absent from OSM, but includes no street address for the Lake Country location and no mention of bike-specific amenities.
